0.original: Hien is, if nothing else, an optimist at heart.

48.original: He's a lot more...straightforward than I expected? And he's certainly not short on confidence.

49.original: But maybe that's the kind of leader Doma needs if they're going to beat these odds. And hey─we've come this far, haven't we? Who's to say we can't go even further?

50.original: Has he truly recovered from his wounds, I wonder? I believe a match may be in order...

51.original: So─you too have heard of the Naadam.

52.original: "The great battle for supremacy of the Steppe.“ I learned of it during my stay with the Mol.

53.original: To my knowledge no foreigners have ever participated, much less triumphed in a Naadam. But, lack of precedent notwithstanding, I should think we would have good standing to bid them march with us to Doma─should we win.

54.original: Will they even permit us to fight, my lord? We belong to no tribe of the Steppe.

55.original: We are not without options, given what Cirina has told me.

56.original: You see, in accordance with the gods' wishes, her people shall participate in the coming Naadam...

57.original: ...And when they take the field, I mean for us to fight alongside them as fellow warriors of the Mol.

58.original: But we need not discuss this at length here. Come, let us head north to Mol Iloh, where Cirina and her people have made camp for this season.

59.original: Cirina came all this way by herself? She's braver than she looks.

60.original: The beasts are never far. I saw more than a few stalking us as we walked. Truly, these lands are fraught with peril.

61.original: My friends, I give you Mol Iloh!

62.original: The khatun of the tribe, Temulun, resides in the largest yurt. We should go and make our introductions.

63.original: It's smaller and more cozy than Reunion. And is that music I hear? It's strange...but somehow comforting...

64.original: For all the grand promises my lord Hien has made, it would not do for us to falter now. We must earn the Mol's blessing.

65.original: I am told you have a knack for making excellent first impressions, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Why don't you lead the way?

66.original: Oh, it's you. Where are your comrades? Did you find Hien?

68.original: I guess we'll have to beat some strong opponents to win this Naadam...

69.original: But that's good, isn't it? I mean, if they were easy to beat, they wouldn't be worth taking back to Doma, would they?

70.original: How confident and bold in speech he has grown. More and more he reminds me of his father in his youth...

71.original: Although I have spent much time with the Mol, I have yet to fully grasp the nature of the udgan and their insights.

72.original: That they value the chance encounter, and the potential fortune it brings, however, is plain. Let us try not to disappoint them!

73.original: Wheresoever you go, remember that you are not alone. Remember that you carry the fire for them, and they for you.

74.original: ...Thank you all for coming, and for offering to fight with us in the Naadam. Though I still fear our chances grim, I am grateful for your assistance.

75.original: To be recognized as warriors of the Mol, there is a trial you must overcome.

76.original: But before we speak of such things, there is another, more pressing matter!
